verdict.rationale: Jules supports delegating tasks via a GitHub issue label ('jules' label) and via API integrations with tools like Slack/Linear/GitHub, but there's no first-party evidence of an in-chat '@jules' tagging/mention workflow for discussion; the closest is a community-built third-party MCP bridge to dispatch tasks from Copilot Chat. Missing for 10: native chat-thread @-mention support, evidence of interactive discussion (not just task creation) within a chat UI, and first-party Slack/Teams bot documentation.
